## Appearance

Gilbert Blythe is a tall boy with curly brown hair and roguish hazel eyes. His mouth is frequently twisted into a teasing smile.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028)_

## Personality

Gilbert Blythe is a clever, good-natured young man with a teasing streak and a strong determination to earn his own way through college. Known for his kind, thoughtful, and self-sacrificing nature, he shows an evident desire to appease others even when met with contempt.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## History

Before returning to school in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), Gilbert Blythe spent three years in Alberta with his sick father and spent the summer visiting cousins in [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick). On his first day back, he teased [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) by calling her 'Carrots,' which resulted in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) smashing her slate over his head and refusing his apology. Despite his attempts to make amends, including rescuing her from a sinking boat on the pond, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) maintained a bitter academic rivalry with him throughout their school years. The pair eventually tied for first place on the island's entrance examinations for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy), where Gilbert went on to win the school medal. After graduating, Gilbert gave up his secured teaching position at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school so that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) could teach closer to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to finally forgive him and enter into a warm friendship.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P14](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Quotes

> “All right!” Gilbert sprang into his skiff with an angry color in his cheeks. “I’ll never ask you to be friends again, Anne Shirley. And I don’t care either!”
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P34](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0034)

> "It wasn’t particularly good of me at all, Anne. I was pleased to be able to do you some small service. Are we going to be friends after this? Have you really forgiven me my old fault?"
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P52](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0052)

> "We were born to be good friends, Anne. You’ve thwarted destiny enough. I know we can help each other in many ways. You are going to keep up your studies, aren’t you? So am I. Come, I’m going to walk home with you."
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P55](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0055)

> “I’m awfully sorry I made fun of your hair, Anne,” he whispered contritely. “Honest I am. Don’t be mad for keeps, now.”
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P49](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0049)

> "It was my fault Mr. Phillips. I teased her."
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--gilbert-blythe.md)

Gilbert and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) maintain a fierce academic rivalry and personal enmity throughout their school years. Their conflict begins when Gilbert calls her 'Carrots' to get her attention, prompting an enraged [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to smash a slate over his head and refuse his apology. Although Gilbert later rescues [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) from a sinking boat and offers his friendship, she rejects him, keeping their intense academic competition for the top of the class intact.

### [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gilbert-blythe--ruby-gillis.md)

Gilbert and Ruby are schoolmates who interact within the same local circle of young people in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). They attend the local school together, participating in shared classroom dynamics and group outings alongside their peers.
